title: Modularize TypeScript code
prompt: `src/report.ts` mixes aggregation with rendering. Move `totalAmount` and `regions` into a new module `src/aggregate.ts` and export both from there, then have `src/report.ts` import and use them. Keep `Sale` exported from `src/report.ts` and `renderReport`'s output byte-for-byte identical. Neither helper may remain defined in `src/report.ts`.
